library(here)
library(knitr)

# Load pre-calculated inline report variables

    current_month    = "Latest Available",
    washtenaw_unemp  = "N/A",
    oakland_unemp    = "N/A",
    livingston_unemp = "N/A",
    mi_unemp         = "N/A",

    ui_claims_total  = "N/A"

}

## Executive Summary (`r report_vars$current_month`)

- **Unemployment Rates:** Washtenaw County recorded an unemployment rate of **`r report_vars$washtenaw_unemp`%**, compared to **`r report_vars$oakland_unemp`%** in Oakland County and **`r report_vars$livingston_unemp`%** in Livingston County. Statewide Michigan benchmark stands at **`r report_vars$mi_unemp`%**.

- **Price Inflation:** Metro Detroit CPI-U posted a year-over-year change of **`r report_vars$detroit_cpi_yoy`%**.

- **Labor Market Drag:** Weekly initial unemployment insurance claims across the corridor totaled **`r report_vars$ui_claims_total`**.
  :::

## 1. Labor Force & Regional Unemployment

The Local Area Unemployment Statistics (LAUS) program tracks labor supply trends across Washtenaw, Oakland, and Livingston (OWL) counties.

![Regional Unemployment Rate Trajectories (LAUS)](`r here::here("plots", "monthly_owl_unemployment.png")`){#fig-laus fig-align="center" width=100%}

## 2. Metro Detroit Payroll Employment Trends

Current Employment Statistics (CES) track nonfarm payroll job trends across the Detroit-Warren-Dearborn Metropolitan Statistical Area (MSA).

![Metro Detroit Payroll Growth Index (Jan 2021 = 100)](`r here::here("plots", "monthly_ces_employment_index.png")`){#fig-ces fig-align="center" width=100%}

## 3. Consumer Price Index & Local Inflation

Regional inflation dynamics measure purchasing power trajectory for urban consumers across the Metro Detroit region.

![Detroit MSA Year-over-Year Inflation Rates (CPI-U)](`r here::here("plots", "monthly_cpi_inflation.png")`){#fig-cpi fig-align="center" width=100%}

## 4. Initial Unemployment Insurance Claims

Weekly initial UI filings serve as a key leading indicator for regional labor market friction and workforce dislocations.

![Weekly Initial UI Claims across OWL Corridor Counties](`r here::here("plots", "monthly_ui_claims.png")`){#fig-ui fig-align="center" width=100%}
